units.source_text: 源氏大将看了这凄凉景象，一时不知所云。

en.t: General Genji looked upon this desolate scene and, for a moment, did not know what to say.

units.source_text: 室内光景异乎寻常：帘子的边缘与帷屏的垂布都用深蓝色。

en.t: The room looked unusual: the edges of the blinds and the hanging cloths of the screens were all in deep blue.

units.source_text: 处处看见淡墨色或赭黄色的衣袖。

en.t: Everywhere one could see sleeves of pale ink-gray or reddish yellow.

units.source_text: 却反而富有清丽优雅之感。

en.t: Yet this only made the scene feel all the more pure, graceful, and elegant.

units.source_text: 只有池面解冻的薄冰和岸边转绿的柳色，没有忘记春天的来临。

en.t: Only the thin ice thawing on the pond and the willows turning green along the bank had not forgotten the coming of spring.

units.source_text: 源氏大将环顾四周，不胜感慨，低声吟唱古歌“久仰松浦岛，今日始得见。

en.t: General Genji looked all around, overcome with feeling, and softly chanted an old poem: "Long have I yearned for Matsura Island; today at last I see it.

units.source_text: 中有渔女居，其心甚可恋”。

en.t: Within it lives a fisher maiden, whose heart seems deeply lovable."
His expression was incomparably refined and carefree.
